pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the mid-neck and upper shoulder, decreasing in spatial area toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light cream-colored pathways with variable thickness. Topological junction nodes primarily exhibit trilateral and quadrilateral intersections with high continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck mane, formed by distinct hair clusters projecting against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized region of textural disruption and greyish hyper-pigmentation on the upper dorsal flank, appearing as a thickened area with lost patch-corridor definition.
